senses.gloss: (אֲלוּנְתִּית) (interchanging with לוּנְטִית q. v.) f. (לוּט, to cover, wrap, cmp.
units: I Sam. XX, 10, a. לאט in H. Dict.; נ inserted) wrapping cloth, sheet, bathing clothes.

<cite ref="Shabbat 40b:3">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>מיחם אדם אלונט׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>אלונת׳</he>, <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:7">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:7">IV</cite>), 7 <he>אלונתת</he>) one may warm a sheet on the Sabbath to put it on the stomach; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:3:3">Y. Sabb. XIX, 17ᵃ</cite> bot. [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80">Gen. R. s. 80</cite> to put on a wound, prob. next w.]—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 8:8:5">Y. Erub. VIII, 25ᵇ</cite> top.—Pl. <he>אֲלוּנְטִיאוֹת</he> <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:5">Sabb. XXII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 147a:11">147ᵃ</cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:15">Tosef. ib. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:15">XVII</cite>), 15 <he>אֲלוּנְטָאוֹת</he> (Var. <cite ref="A01922"><he>אֲלֻנְטִיאוֹת</he></cite>, <he>לֻנְטִיאוֹת</he>).
